column1: mode    unsynced  -  ahead of or behind the upstream                       -
mode    todos     -  with open TODO.md items                               -
sort    recent    -  last commit, newest first                             default
action  edit      ctrl-e  open the repository in $EDITOR                   foreground
action  fetch     -       git fetch the selected repositories              foreground,reload
action  pull      -       git pull --ff-only the selected repositories     foreground,reload
action  browse    alt-w   open the remote in the browser                   silent
action  rescan    -       scan every repository again now                  foreground,reload
